screenshots.caption: The installed application displays the real portfolio homepage, native navigation and immutable snapshot identity. Its bundled catalog includes 67 project pages and 66 other current application records.
Keyboard and native navigation reach the actual About page. Public reference and contact links require a separate confirmation before opening an external browser.

observedTests.name: Installed consumer
observedTests.observed: Original complete journey: two normal exits, source identity, responsive layouts, project search/history, all current download pages and JSON. All 196 program files unchanged.

observedTests.name: Isolation and closure
observedTests.observed: Native isolation and permission/network/popup refusal passed, as did Cancel/Open, durable restart and held confirmation through Quit/Close. Only the OS dialog and external opener were substituted.

observedTests.name: Delivery and source
observedTests.observed: Five provider downloads matched identities. Desktop and Start-menu targets read back. All three main workflows and two processed CodeQL categories passed. Ordinary default-profile icon activation was not performed.
